item.title: Please remove this fourth car park direction sign fronting 1, St John's Cottages at the jct of Maple Rd and Blenheim Rd., 1st August
item.description:
Please remove this fourth car park direction sign fronting 1, St John's Cottages at the jct of Maple Rd and Blenheim Rd. Bromley Council sold the Blenheim Shopping Centre and multi storey car park about a decade or more ago. The new property speculators have emptied the Blenheim Centre shops and closed the multi storey car park about a year ago. The developers have permission to replace the centre and car park with blocks of flats with no public off street parking. Please remove this now redundant and misleading 'P' for parking plus arrow directional sign.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Maple Road, Penge, Greater London
